title: Print the matrix in spiral manner
stepTitle: Solve Problems on Arrays [Easy -> Medium -> Hard]
category: Solve Problems on Arrays [Easy -> Medium -> Hard]
problemStatement: Print all elements of a matrix in spiral order.
intuition: Maintain top/bottom/left/right walls. Traverse one wall, then retract it. The only subtlety is re-checking the bounds before the two return legs.

approaches.title: Optimal: boundary simulation
approaches.idea: Right across the top, down the right, left across the bottom, up the left; repeat.
approaches.dryRun:
3x3: top row 1,2,3 (top=1)
right col 6,9 (right=1)
bottom row 8,7 (bottom=1)
left col 4 (left=1)
remaining top row 5
approaches.whyWorks: Each cell lies on exactly one wall at the moment it is visited.

commonMistakes: Skipping the `if top <= bottom` / `if left <= right` guards, which double-prints the middle line
patternRecognition: Layer-by-layer matrix traversal with shrinking boundaries
followUps: Spiral traversal of a binary tree (level order zig-zag)
interviewInsight: Single-row and single-column matrices are the fastest way to expose a missing guard. Test them aloud.
